definitions: To accept death or an ending peacefully and without resistance.
To face the end of life or a significant phase with calm acceptance rather than fighting against it.
examples: After a long illness, he chose to go gentle into that good night, surrounded by his family.
She decided to go gentle into that good night, embracing the changes rather than resisting them.
The company, facing inevitable closure, decided to go gentle into that good night, ensuring a smooth transition for its employees.
lemma: go gentle into that good night
